viaje.start_desc: A real process. Three cards each day: morning, midday and night. No shortcuts.
viaje.start_how_1: 20 days with yourself. A process, not a game. Go at your pace, no skipping steps.
viaje.start_how_2: Each day, three cards: morning, midday and night. Each one opens at its hour.
viaje.start_how_3: You move through four phases: Awaken, Descend, Cross and Return.
viaje.start_how_4: From each card you keep one word. At the end you'll have the full map of your journey.
viaje.umbral_1: Standing up, write: «What I fear most to find here is…»
viaje.umbral_2: Read out loud the Descend card that shook you most.
viaje.umbral_3: Write an excuse you've used your whole life. Cross it out.

paso.intro_desc: PASO is a short test that reveals how you move through life: how you decide, how you relate, how you keep your pace, and how you read the terrain before stepping on it.
paso.intro_how: You'll see 28 groups of four phrases. In each one, mark the one CLOSEST to you and the one that's LEAST. Even if none fits perfectly, pick the closest: it's a comparison, not a label. There are no right or wrong answers.
paso.example_intro: Before you start, try it with something easy. Mark what you like MOST with + and what you like LEAST with −. That's exactly what you'll do in the test.
paso.example_done: That's it. It's that simple. Now you'll do it with how you walk.
paso.test_prompt: Which one is CLOSEST to you, and which is LEAST? Even if none defines you fully, pick the closest.
paso.pattern_framing: One of the 15 ways of walking — the one your answers draw today, not a label.
paso.que_es_intro: PASO doesn't tell you who you are. It looks at how you walk through life through four ways of moving. None is better than another: we all carry the four, in different measure.
paso.que_es_P: The energy with which you decide, take a stand and move forward, even when the path asks you to face something difficult.
paso.que_es_A: The way you connect, express what you feel and create bonds, closeness and a sense of belonging.
paso.que_es_S: The ability to remain calm, protect your pace and keep your commitments when things need time.
paso.que_es_O: The attention with which you read the terrain, understand nuance and seek clarity before taking your next step.
paso.curva_hint: The higher the zone, the more pronounced that way of walking. The balance line is the neutral point.
paso.firma_desc: Here the four ways always appear in the same order: Press on, Accompany, Sustain and Observe. It is not a ranking. Each axis sits in its zone, from 1 (slight) to 7 (very pronounced); zone 4 is balance.
paso.separas_title: Where there is more distance between what you show and what you need
paso.separas_intro: This section is ordered from the greatest distance to the smallest. Points do not say whether you are better or worse at a way of walking: they measure how much your outward response differs from what comes naturally inside.
paso.separas_repeat: Several ways may share the same sentence. That simply means their distance moves in the same direction.
paso.separas_gap: The biggest gap is in «{dim}». It's the distance between what you show on the outside and the terrain you carry inside.
paso.dir_exige: you push yourself more than comes naturally
paso.dir_esconde: you hold back more than you show
paso.separas_puntos: {n, plural, one {# point of distance} other {# points of distance}}
paso.book: The book that resonates most with you
paso.nota_espejo: PASO isn't a scientific test or a diagnosis. It's a mirror: what your answers draw, a direction to look at yourself. It doesn't say who you are, but how you walk today — and that can always change.
paso.cta_account: Create a free account to save your result and keep exploring the method.
paso.pdf_hint: Download saves it directly. Share attaches the complete PDF.

paso.rareza_habitual: A less common way of walking
paso.mapa_intro: Yours is marked. How common each one is is only an approximation, and none is better than another: we all carry some of the four.
